note: What a thin surface must REFUSE to answer. Without these the suite only proves an implementation can compute what it can — never that it declines what it cannot. A min/max that answers here is the worst bug this system admits. The price case is not a design choice: it is a theorem that no weighting of debits can reproduce a price.

coverage.criterion: one case per reason a thin surface has to defer or error
coverage.why: one per reason, not exhaustive over inputs; a new reason needs a new case

cases.name: two independent groupings are not a chain
cases.why: off a chain the premium stops being zero, so min/max is no longer exact

cases.name: a price needs the engine
cases.why: proven, not asserted: no weighting of debits, of (debit,state) pairs, or of pairs of debits reproduces the price. Least squares bounds every weighting at once and leaves 61.9% of the maximum unexplained on a four-element population, with 131 columns of rank 71 against 225 declarations — so it is not a shortage of parameters

cases.name: a level nobody declared
cases.why: a guessed level produces a real verdict about the wrong thing

cases.name: a unit impossible before anyone composed it
cases.why: nothing collided; one promise was written wrong, and calling that a collision hides the typo
